    The graded first-arrow sequence of Π(Δ) #

    periodic-mesh-calculations.tex (proof of the bound by the U_d): "The first-arrow presentation of each simple gives, as in (A.1), an exact sequence e_iΠ⟨2⟩ → ⊕_{j∼i} e_jΠ⟨1⟩ → e_iΠ → S_i → 0. Exactness at the middle term is proved as for (A.1)."

    We fix the endpoint j and the degree. Write h_i(d) = dim e_i Π_d e_j. The middle exactness (exact_star, proved for Proposition 4.1) and the grading of the ideal give ∑_{l∼i} h_l(d+1) ≤ h_i(d+2) + h_i(d) and ∑_{l∼i} h_l(0) ≤ h_i(1); these are the inequalities κ ≥ 0 of UBound.
